clusters.name: Heating & Hot Water
clusters.description: Heating and hot-water services for Chicago homes, from furnaces and boilers to space heaters and radiant systems.
clusters.buildNote: Everything that makes heat or hot water. This is the largest cluster by demand and the company's core trade.

clusters.name: Cooling
clusters.description: Cooling options for Chicago buildings with and without existing ductwork, including central air, ductless and room units.
clusters.buildNote: Everything that removes heat. Chicago's large stock without central air makes this cluster broader than central AC alone.

clusters.name: Whole-System HVAC & Controls
clusters.description: Whole-system repair, replacement and control upgrades that connect heating, cooling and comfort management.
clusters.buildNote: Whole-system jobs and the controls that run them, where the customer is replacing or upgrading rather than fixing one appliance.

clusters.name: Indoor Air Quality & Ventilation
clusters.description: Services that move, filter and condition indoor air, including ductwork, purification, humidity and exhaust ventilation.
clusters.buildNote: The source cluster contains nine topics, but general and portable fans are retail-only and intentionally have no service page. Eight pages are buildable.

clusters.name: Fireplace, Chimney & Solid Fuel
clusters.description: Fireplace, chimney and solid-fuel topics grouped for navigation, with each service held for scope confirmation before publication.
clusters.buildNote: This entire cluster is scope-flagged in the source workbook. Confirm hearth and chimney capabilities before publishing its service pages.

clusters.name: Commercial & Specialty
clusters.description: Commercial refrigeration and specialty equipment topics that require confirmed company scope before they become public services.
clusters.buildNote: Both services are scope-flagged. Refrigeration is light-commercial work and standby generators are normally an electrical trade.
